content.text:
I fixed the site, and both visual tests (desktop and phone) now pass against the approved screenshots.

The cause was three wrong values in `site/css/styles.css`. The repo has only one commit, so I found them by comparing the screenshots with the rules:

- **Container width (line 661):** at 1200px and wider, `.container` had `max-width: 570px`. I set it to `1140px`. This was why the desktop page was squeezed into a narrow column.
- **Large-screen padding (line 10157):** `.px-lg-5` had `padding-right: 1.5rem` against `3rem` on the left. I set the right side to `3rem`. This was why the content sat off-centre.
- **Phone padding (line 7872):** `.p-4` was `0.75rem`. I set it to `1.5rem`. This was why the jumbotron and cards were too tight on phones.

I only changed those three values, and I didn't update any screenshots.

STATUS: DONE

- **Phone padding (line 7872):** `.p-4` was `0.75rem`. I set it to `1.5rem`. This was why the jumbotron and cards were too tight on phones.

I only changed those three values, and I didn't update any screenshots.
